narration.text: Distributor deductions, disputed. This is a chore for a 4-million-dollar natural-foods snack brand selling through UNFI and KeHE, with a part-time finance person. Each month the distributors pay less than they owe: promotions, shortages, spoils, fees, pricing. Athena works it across 4 portals: myUNFI Dispute Center, KeHE K-Solve, Brand Drive and Warehouse portal. On the bench, she found 7 of 7 eligible items, worth 10,882 dollars of the 10,882 dollars there was to find. All 7 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 10 traps, and she walked past 10. Among them: A promotion deducted at the approved rate, plus KeHE's 8 percent fee — both valid. A shortage the proof of delivery itself notes as short. She took 4 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 15 hours, so she was about 214 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 35 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
